subject: GreenLeaf Health — pre-audit evidence request: employee vetting & training
messages:

Cc: Ethan Wright <ewright@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GreenLeaf Health — Pre-audit evidence request (SOC 2)

Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off the scoping work for GreenLeaf Health's SOC 2 Type II pre-audit and need to collect evidence related to employee vetting and training for the population in scope. Specifically we'd like the following artifacts: 

- A roster (CSV) of employees and contractors in scope with hire date, role, location, and manager. Redacted PII is acceptable (employee id or initials).
- Evidence that annual security awareness training was completed for employees in scope (completion dates / certificates).
- Background-check confirmations for hires since 2024-01-01 (vendor, date completed, pass/flag).
- Onboarding checklist template(s) and offboarding logs showing access revocation for terminated users.
- Any documented policy around retention/deletion of HR vetting data.

If you have these items already compiled, please send them over (redacted PDFs or CSVs are fine). If not, a short plan and ETA for delivery is fine; we can accept staged delivery. We also prefer a Drive link if files exceed 5MB.

Thanks,

Audits Team
ThirdParty Audits LLP
[audits@thirdpartyaudits.com]

Per Tessa's note I've compiled a background-check summary (redacted) and exported recent offboarding logs. Attachments included: 
- background-check-summary-redacted.pdf (vendor summaries, dates, flags; names replaced with employee IDs)
- offboarding-logs-2025-Q4.csv (account revocations and last activity timestamps)
- onboarding-checklist-templates.docx (standard checklist we use for new hires)

- For terminated users included in the offboarding log, access revocation was completed within 24 hours in all recorded cases; screenshots of IAM activity are available upon request.

[Attachment: background-check-summary-redacted.pdf (PDF), offboarding-logs-2025-Q4.csv (CSV), onboarding-checklist-templates.docx (DOCX)]

Quick technical confirmation: 

- Retention / deletion policy: HR vetting artifacts (vendor reports) are retained for up to 7 years per our retention schedule; derived metadata (vendor name, result, date) is stored in HRDB for 3 years. The formal policy is in the security docs folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cGLH-SOC2-evidence (see file: hr-vetting-retention-2025.pdf)
- Deletion workflow: we have an automated job that removes vendor reports from the secure storage location after 7 years; there is a manual verification step logged in Jira ticket SEC-834.

If the auditors need a copy of the policy and the Jira audit trail, I can export the ticket history and add it to the Drive folder (will redact internal comments not relevant to the audit).
